name: notebooklm
description: Export compiled book Markdown, highlights, and notes to Google NotebookLM via browser handoff, webhook bridge, or Google Cloud Discovery Engine.

notebook_url.title: NotebookLM Web URL
notebook_url.description: Target NotebookLM browser URL opened after downloading or pushing Markdown.

webhook_url.title: Webhook / Bridge URL (Optional)
webhook_url.description: Optional HTTP(S) webhook bridge endpoint to push compiled book Markdown directly.

endpoint.title: Discovery Engine Endpoint (Optional)
endpoint.description: Optional custom Google Cloud Discovery Engine API base endpoint.

project_id.title: Google Cloud Project ID (Optional)
project_id.description: Google Cloud Project ID for NotebookLM Enterprise Discovery Engine API.

api_key.title: Bearer Token / API Key (Optional)
api_key.description: Optional Bearer token or OAuth access token for Webhook or Google Cloud Discovery Engine.

actions.name: send_to_notebooklm
actions.title: Send to NotebookLM
actions.description: Push compiled book Markdown with highlights and notes to NotebookLM or download for browser handoff.

tools.name: send_book_to_notebooklm
tools.description: Send a Shelfd book's compiled Markdown (metadata, synopsis, highlights, notes, and chapters) to Google NotebookLM or prepare a browser handoff.

book_id.description: The Shelfd book ID to send to NotebookLM.
